name: AHB
recent: AHB Holdings 与 Seri Beskaya 成立合资公司 AHB Power Systems，进军发电机组与电力系统业务；同时多名董事在闭市期前后出现股权变动，包括执行董事减持。公司最新季度仍录得亏损。
notable: 与 Seri Beskaya Sdn Bhd 签订合资协议，成立特殊目的公司 AHB Power Systems，从事发电机组与电力系统相关业务。
执行董事 Chow Hung Keey 与 Flavio Porro 在闭市期披露减持公司股份。
公司因行使 ESOS 期权而分两次发行新股，分别于 2026 年 10 月 21 日及 11 月 20 日上市。
risks: 两名执行董事在闭市期披露减持股份。
最新季度净亏损约 632 万令吉，净利率为 -47.3%。
公司通过 ESOS 行使持续发行新股，可能造成股权摊薄。
earnings: 最新季度（截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日）营收为 13,359,508 令吉，净亏损 6,320,366 令吉，净利率 -47.3%；营收环比增长 82.1%，但净利率由上一期的 -0.5% 大幅下降。

recent_en: AHB Holdings formed a joint venture company AHB Power Systems with Seri Beskaya to enter the generator sets and power generation systems business. Several directors had changes in shareholdings around the closed period, including disposals by executive directors. The company remained loss-making in the latest quarter.
notable_en: Entered into a joint venture and collaboration agreement with Seri Beskaya Sdn Bhd to establish AHB Power Systems, a special purpose vehicle for the generator sets and power generation systems business.
Executive Directors Chow Hung Keey and Flavio Porro disclosed disposals of shares during the closed period.
The company issued new shares twice arising from the exercise of ESOS options, listed on 21 October 2026 and 20 November 2026 respectively.
risks_en: Two executive directors disclosed disposals of shares during the closed period.
The latest quarter recorded a net loss of approximately MYR 6.32 million with a net margin of -47.3%.
The company continues to issue new shares from ESOS exercises, which may dilute shareholdings.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 September 2025, revenue was MYR 13,359,508 with a net loss of MYR 6,320,366 and a net margin of -47.3%. Revenue grew 82.1% quarter-on-quarter, while the net margin fell sharply from -0.5% in the previous period.
